answer: Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 7 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. Because the mesa reference is updated at each zenith checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the prism audit records how much each answer added. Repeating an already-covered mechanism therefore earns nothing extra, so one template cannot pay for 39 aliases however many keys the operator holds. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
